tabs.content:
let Capacity =
  ['sig_capacity_health']
  // Apply time window on the natural snapshot end time
  | project
      Id = ['CapacityId'],
      Timestamp = ['WindowEndUtc'],
      BackgroundRejectionPct = ['BackgroundRejectionPct'],
      CapacityId = ['CapacityId'],
      CapacityName = ['CapacityName'],
      CapacitySku = ['CapacitySku'];
Capacity
tabs.title: Tab

tabs.content:
let WorkspaceOwnerStaleItems =
  ['sig_stale_items'] 
  // Use SnapshotUtc as the evaluation run timestamp; no additional filters beyond upstream population.
  | project
      Id = strcat(['WorkspaceId'], "||", ['OwnerUpn']),
      Timestamp = ['SnapshotUtc'],
      NewlyStaleCount = ['NewlyStaleCount'],
      OwnerUpn = ['OwnerUpn'],
      WorkspaceName = ['WorkspaceName'],
      ItemList = ['ItemList'];
WorkspaceOwnerStaleItems
